close-grip-lat-pulldown.criteria: Seated close neutral grip using narrow parallel attachment; feet planted, thighs held by pad, pull toward upper chest and return with control.

hip-adduction-machine.criteria: Seated supported torso, inner knees against pads; draw thighs together then controlled opening; feet supported on moving footplates.

kettlebell-press.criteria: Single left-arm strict press from shoulder rack to overhead, bell behind forearm, feet and trunk stable, controlled lowering.

limits: Procedural shared human and simplified equipment; exercise-specific motion. Sampled checks are not full mesh collision or biomechanical certification. Local only; production and device pending.
